summary: ZenaTech filed a Form 6-K with interim unaudited consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the six months ended June 30, 2026, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3/A shelf. No transaction event is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer. It notes retrospective IFRS 3 measurement-period adjustments relating to a prior Empire acquisition, plus a $16.7M warrant liability and rising goodwill. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. Watch for subsequent-event disclosures and shelf takedown activity.
